Downstream evaluation slices will require block explorer or public RPC queries to enumerate remaining admin/control contracts. Protocol describes imminent app-chain architecture, suggesting additional contract deployments in progress.

protocol_metadata.about: Extended is a perpetual derivatives DEX built by an ex-Revolut team, deployed on Starknet mainnet with support for 100+ trading pairs including crypto, equities, commodities, and FX with up to 100x leverage. Users maintain full self-custody of USDC collateral in on-chain smart contracts settled via Starknet's zero-knowledge proofs, with XVS as a yield-generating vault token. The protocol is transitioning toward decentralized sequencing via a custom application-specific chain while preserving Starknet security guarantees.
